tracking: ADR-0364 S2 (lane E45): API-only by the master brief (2026-11-19); the Robots screens (list, detail, review) are for the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/robots: pages the robots the caller owns (all, for an admin) with their computed status and how many agents use them
gaps.POST /v1/robots: creates a robot (browser engine only in this release), owned by the caller, audited
gaps.GET /v1/robots/:robotId: one robot with every version (content, allow-list, bindings, lifecycle) and its secrets' names and last four (never a value)
gaps.POST /v1/robots/:robotId/retire: retires a robot: approved versions retired and their tools halted, drafts discarded, a pending review superseded, audited
gaps.POST /v1/robots/:robotId/versions: drafts a new robot version (steps_v1 script, https allow-list, secret bindings), audited
gaps.PUT /v1/robots/:robotId/versions/:versio: replaces a draft version's content; refused once it is submitted (frozen), audited
gaps.POST /v1/robots/:robotId/versions/:versi: submits a draft for review in the approvals queue, bound to its content digest; needs a passing test run on that digest, audited
retires an approved robot version and halts its tool, audited
gaps.PUT /v1/robots/:robotId/secrets/:name/:s: sets a robot's live or test secret, encrypted (settings_relax step-up, audited without the value)
gaps.DELETE /v1/robots/:robotId/secrets/:name: clears a robot secret no submitted version is bound to, audited
